privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.versionLine: Version 1.0 · Last updated: 4 August 2026 · The Danish version is authoritative
privacy.s1controller: Asp Productions ApS, Danish company reg. no. (CVR) 36708077, Raffinaderivej 20, DK-2300 Copenhagen S, Denmark. KlangHaus is a trading name of Asp Productions ApS.
privacy.s1dpoNote: We are not required to appoint a Data Protection Officer and have not done so; inquiries are handled by management.
privacy.s21data: Data: name, email address, password (hashed), organisation membership, roles, login timestamps, session and security logs, 2FA data where enabled.
privacy.s21purpose: Purpose: account creation and operation, access control, security.
privacy.s21basis: Legal basis: GDPR art. 6(1)(b) (contract) and 6(1)(f) (legitimate interest in secure operation and abuse prevention).
privacy.s22data: Data: your projects, tokens and configurations to the extent they contain personal data (typically they do not), member lists, audit log of actions, API-key metadata.
privacy.s22purpose: Purpose: providing the service, version history, traceability, security.
privacy.s23data: Data: billing name and address, VAT number, plan and payment history, masked card details (e.g. card brand + last 4 digits). Full card data is processed solely by our payment provider (Stripe) — we never store it ourselves.
privacy.s23purpose: Purpose: charging, invoicing, bookkeeping, VAT reporting.
privacy.s23basis: Legal basis: art. 6(1)(b) and 6(1)(c) (legal obligations under Danish bookkeeping and tax law).
privacy.s24data: Data: your inquiry and the information you provide.
privacy.s24purpose: Purpose: answering and documenting the inquiry.
privacy.s25data: Data: technical error events (may include user ID and IP address), operational metrics. Error reports are sent from your browser directly to our error-reporting provider (Sentry, EU region). No cookies are set, and the data is not used to track you across websites.
privacy.s25basis: Legal basis: art. 6(1)(f). Error data is retained briefly (see section 7).
privacy.s26data: Analytics: we currently collect no analytics about your use of Studio. If we enable it later, it will run on a self-hosted solution (Matomo) and only after your consent, withdrawable at any time with the same ease.
privacy.s26purpose: Marketing (newsletters etc.): only with your prior, active consent. Consent is never a condition for using the service and is never bundled with accepting the terms of service.
privacy.s2noTracking: We use no third-party tracking. Our bot protection (ALTCHA) is self-hosted and sets no third-party cookies.
privacy.s3p: We collect data from you and from your use of the service. If you were added as a member of an organisation by someone else (e.g. your employer or a client who invited you), we received your name and email from that organisation (an art. 14 situation) — the organisation is responsible for having a basis for inviting you.
privacy.s4controller: For account, payment, support and operational data we are the controller.
privacy.s4processor: For content our B2B customers place in the service (e.g. their end-users' data in customer-controlled projects) the customer is the controller and we act as processor under a data processing agreement (art. 28).
privacy.s5p: We never sell your data. We disclose it only to: (a) our processors (section 6), (b) public authorities where legally required, (c) our auditor/advisers under confidentiality, and (d) the payment provider Stripe, which for the payment transaction itself also acts as an independent controller (e.g. fraud prevention under its own rules).
privacy.s6intro: This list is verified against our actual systems. Business customers: see also our data processing agreement.
privacy.s6vimeoNote: Vimeo removed from the list: not used in Studio (other products' video surfaces only — revisit at their launch).
privacy.s6currentList: The list in force at any time appears on
privacy.s7r1val: While the account exists; deleted on account deletion (art. 17 cascade) and out of all backups no later than 90 days afterwards
privacy.s7r2val: Until termination + 30-day export window, cf. Terms §12
privacy.s7r4val: 5 years from end of financial year (Danish Bookkeeping Act)
privacy.s7r7val: While consent is active + 3 years (proof of lawful processing)
privacy.s8rights: Under the GDPR you have the right of access (art. 15), rectification (art. 16), erasure (art. 17), restriction (art. 18), data portability (art. 20) and objection (art. 21), and the right to withdraw consent at any time (without affecting processing before withdrawal).
privacy.s8selfService: Account deletion and data export are available directly in the service's self-service. Other requests:
privacy.s8noAutomated: We make no decisions based solely on automated processing that produce legal effects concerning you (art. 22).
privacy.s9p: You may lodge a complaint with the Danish Data Protection Agency (Datatilsynet), Carl Jacobsens Vej 35, DK-2500 Valby, www.datatilsynet.dk. We would appreciate the chance to resolve the matter first.
privacy.s10p: Material changes to this policy are notified by email or in the service. This policy's version and date appear at the top.

dpa.title: Data Processing Agreement (DPA)
dpa.intakeBody: The data processing agreement is concluded as an annex to the Grundtone Studio subscription agreement. The agreement text is undergoing external legal review and is available on request via
dpa.intro: When your organisation places content containing personal data in Grundtone Studio, your organisation is the controller and Asp Productions ApS (Danish CVR 36708077, trading as KlangHaus) is the processor under GDPR art. 28. This page describes the framework — it is not the agreement itself.
dpa.scope: We process solely on documented instructions from the customer. The instructions consist of the subscription agreement, the data processing agreement and the customer's configuration and use of the service's features.

processing.purpose: Subject matter: operating Grundtone Studio — hosting, versioning and CDN publication of the customer's design tokens/brand configurations plus associated user and access management.
processing.duration: Duration: the term of the subscription agreement plus the export window and deletion at termination.
processing.dataTypes: Data types: name, email, role/membership, action log (audit), technical identifiers (IP, session ID). No special categories (art. 9) — the service is not intended for them.
processing.subjects: Categories of data subjects: the customer's employees/members in the service.

security.encryption: Encryption: TLS on all transport; managed databases encrypted at rest incl. backups.
security.access: Access control: role-based access, tenant isolation, access on a need-to-know basis.
security.audit: Traceability: audit log of administrative actions; separated environments; EU hosting.
security.incident: Breaches: we notify the customer without undue delay, enabling the customer to meet its 72-hour deadline (art. 33).

dpa.subProcessors: The customer gives general prior authorisation for the sub-processors on our list; changes are notified in writing at least 30 days before use. See
dpa.termination: At termination we delete or return (at the customer's choice) all personal data, unless law requires retention. The service includes self-service export (art. 20) and deletion (art. 17); the export window appears in the Terms §12.
dpa.law: The agreement follows the subscription agreement's provisions on governing law and venue (Danish law).

integrationGuide.title: Integration guide
integrationGuide.intro: Drop your published Grundtone tokens into any frontend. Pick the snippet that matches your stack.
integrationGuide.keyNoticeBody: Create one inside Studio under the project's 'API keys' tab.
integrationGuide.sriHeading: Production: pin a version + use Sub-Resource Integrity
integrationGuide.sriBody: For long-lived production deploys, pin to an immutable version URL and add an SRI hash. The corresponding hash is served at the same path with a .sri suffix.
integrationGuide.modeBody: The SDK applies the theme matching the chosen mode. Use 'auto' to follow the OS preference.
integrationGuide.ssrBody: In Nuxt, Next.js and other server-rendered frameworks, put the tokens.css link in the server-rendered head, as in the Nuxt and Next.js tabs. The brand is then in place before first paint, without JavaScript. The client plugin applies the brand only after JavaScript has run, so use it for single-page apps.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.projectIdHelp: Used by the tokens CLI and API to identify the project.
apiKeys.keyTypeHelp: Publishable keys are read-only and safe in client code. Secret keys grant write access to the project's tokens (e.g. via the tokens CLI) — treat them like a password and never put them in client code or URLs.
apiKeys.whatIsItTooltip: An API key (pk_live_…) is a publishable token your customer app uses to fetch this project's design tokens. It's safe to ship in client code — like Stripe's pk_live keys. Lock it to specific origins below to limit who can use it.
apiKeys.allowedOriginsHelp: One per line, e.g. 'acme.com' or '*.acme.com'. Empty = any origin allowed.
apiKeys.rateLimitHelp: Per-key cap enforced by the CDN endpoint. 1000 covers a typical landing page; raise it for high-traffic sites.
apiKeys.shownOnce: Copy the key now — it will only be shown this once
apiKeys.shownOnceBody: We only store a hash of the key. Lose it and you must generate a new one.
apiKeys.confirmRevoke: Are you sure you want to revoke this key? It cannot be used again.
apiKeys.envTooltip: Live keys serve published tokens in production. Test keys are for development/CI — same data, but separated in access logs and rate limits.

keysHelp.summary: What is the difference between pk_ and sk_ keys?
keysHelp.pk: pk_ (publishable): a read key for fetching published tokens from the CDN. It is designed to live visibly in your app code and URLs — it cannot change anything.
keysHelp.sk: sk_ (secret): a write key for the API (e.g. CI/CD and token updates). It is shown only ONCE at creation and should be treated like a password — put it in your CI’s secrets, never in code.

plansFaq.title: Frequently asked questions
plansFaq.brandQ: What counts as an active brand?
plansFaq.brandA: A project with a published version — tokens that are live on the CDN. Drafts are free and never count.
plansFaq.switchQ: Can I switch or cancel my plan?
plansFaq.switchA: Yes, any time. Downgrades and cancellations take effect from the next billing period — your tokens and drafts are never deleted, and already-published versions keep working.
plansFaq.limitQ: What happens when I hit my limit?
plansFaq.limitA: Nothing breaks: everything live stays live. You just can’t publish MORE brands until you upgrade (or unpublish another). On plans with overage you pay per extra brand instead.

terms.s4p1: Tjenesten udbydes i de planer der fremgår af den til enhver tid gældende prisside på `studio.grundtone.com/plans` ("Prissiden"). Prissiden angiver pr. plan: pris, antal inkluderede aktive brands, eventuel pris pr. ekstra brand (overage), og feature-indhold. Prissiden udgør en del af aftalen ved bestilling.
terms.s4p2: **Gratis plan:** giver ret til det antal projekter der fremgår af Prissiden (p.t. 2), begge fuldt publicerbare. Den gratis plan leveres uden driftsgarantier og er underlagt fair use (§8).
terms.s4p3: Kvoter håndhæves ved oprettelse/publicering af nye projekter og brands. **En kvote-ændring berører aldrig dine eksisterende projekter eller allerede publicerede brands** — du kan aldrig miste adgang til eksisterende indhold alene som følge af en kvote- eller planændring fra vores side.
terms.s4p4: Planer med overage: brands ud over det inkluderede antal faktureres pr. påbegyndt faktureringsperiode til den sats der fremgik af Prissiden ved bestilling, jf. dog §6. Planer uden overage (p.t. Solo) har en hård grænse; yderligere brands kræver planskifte.

terms.s5p2: Abonnementet forudbetales pr. faktureringsperiode (måned eller år, jf. bestilling). Overage faktureres for den faktiske brand-mængde i perioden.
terms.s5p3: Betaling sker via vores betalingsformidler (Stripe). Vi opbevarer ikke selv kortdata. Betalingsmetoden debiteres automatisk ved hver periodes start.
terms.s5p5: **Momsnumre og omvendt betalingspligt:** Oplyser du et EU-momsnummer, faktureres der uden dansk moms efter reglerne om omvendt betalingspligt (reverse charge). Du indestår for, at nummeret er gyldigt og tilhører din virksomhed. Viser nummeret sig ugyldigt ved validering (VIES), og leverer du ikke et gyldigt nummer inden **14 dage** efter vores henvendelse, (a) pålægges fremtidige fakturaer moms, indtil et gyldigt nummer foreligger, og (b) er vi berettiget til at efteropkræve den moms, der skulle have været opkrævet på fakturaer udstedt på grundlag af det ugyldige nummer.
terms.s6p1: Priser markeret som **"introduktionspriser"** på Prissiden forventes at stige i takt med at Tjenesten udvides.
terms.s6p2: **Prisgarantien:** Tegner du et betalt abonnement til en introduktionspris, garanterer vi at **din pris pr. plan-enhed — dvs. den månedlige plan-pris og den overage-sats pr. ekstra brand der gjaldt ved din bestilling — ikke forhøjes i 12 måneder regnet fra din første betalte faktureringsperiodes startdato.**

terms.s6p3d: Den bortfalder ved misligholdelse der fører til ophævelse (§10.4).
terms.s6p4: Efter garantiperiodens udløb kan prisen ændres efter §15.2 (30 dages varsel til en periodes udløb).
terms.s7p1: Abonnementet løber i den valgte faktureringsperiode og fornys automatisk, indtil det opsiges. **Ingen bindingsperiode ud over den igangværende, forudbetalte periode.**

Ved vedvarende overskridelse kontakter vi dig med henblik på opgradering; vi throttler eller afbryder først leverancen, hvis henvendelse er forblevet ubesvaret i rimelig tid, eller ved åbenbart misbrug.

terms.s9p1: Tjenesten må ikke bruges til: (a) ulovligt indhold eller ulovlige formål, (b) krænkelse af tredjemands rettigheder, (c) forsøg på at omgå adgangsstyring, kvoter eller sikkerhedsforanstaltninger, (d) belastning der bringer driften for andre kunder i fare.
terms.s9p2: Ved overtrædelse kan vi suspendere efter §10. Ved alvorlig eller gentagen overtrædelse kan vi ophæve aftalen uden varsel.
terms.s10p1: **Betalingsfejl:** Mislykkes en automatisk betaling, giver vi dig besked og forsøger igen. Din adgang fortsætter uændret i en **betalingsfrist på 3 dage** fra forfald ("grace-perioden").
terms.s10p2: **Suspension:** Er betalingen ikke gennemført ved grace-periodens udløb, kan vi suspendere organisationens adgang til Tjenesten. Under suspension er login, API-adgang og øvrige funktioner lukket. **Allerede publicerede brands udleveres dog fortsat via CDN i 14 dage fra suspensionens start** ("CDN-grace-perioden"), så dine slutbrugere ikke rammes uvarslet. Er betaling ikke sket ved CDN-grace-periodens udløb, depubliceres organisationens brands med virkning **senest to timer derefter (typisk øjeblikkeligt)**.
terms.s10p3: Suspension ophæves straks når det skyldige beløb er betalt. Data slettes ikke som følge af suspension.
terms.s10p4: **Ophævelse:** Er betaling ikke sket senest 30 dage efter suspension, eller ved væsentlig misligholdelse i øvrigt, kan vi ophæve aftalen. §12 (dine data) gælder også efter ophævelse.

terms.s11p2: Support leveres pr. plan som angivet på Prissiden. Selvbetjenings-dokumentation er den primære supportkanal på gratis- og lav-prisplaner.
terms.s11p3: Vi videreudvikler Tjenesten løbende og kan ændre funktioner, forudsat at Tjenestens kerneydelse (token-styring, versionering, publicering, CDN-leverance) ikke forringes væsentligt. Væsentlige forringelser behandles efter §15.
